meta.title: BAL Waterproof 1C 5ltr | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Designed for tanking internal wet walls in a single application, the BAL Waterproof 1C is a ready to use polymer system made up of 40% recycled material. It provides complete waterproofing protection of substrates prior to fixing internal wall and floor tiles. Simply prime your surface first with undiluted BAL Primer 1C and allow to dry for 15-30 minutes.

It can bridge cracks of 2-3mm without the need for tape whilst its fibre strand technology provides improved strength, simply apply with a roller, 4mm notched trowel or brush and you can tile on top in just two hours.

Suitable substrates: Concrete, rendering, Tile Backer Boards, Cement Sand Screed, Anhydrite Screeds, Hard Natural Stone, Glazed/Unglazed Ceramic Tiles, Timber Floors, Plaster*, Plasterboard* and Ply Overlay* (*not recommended substrates for use in wet or shower areas).
result.short_description: Designed for tanking internal wet walls in a single application, the BAL Waterproof 1C is a ready to use polymer system made up of 40% recycled material. It provides complete waterproofing protection of substrates prior to fixing internal wall and floor tiles.

meta.description: Kerakoll H40 Extreme Adhesive 10kg
meta.title: Kerakoll H40 Extreme Adhesive 10kg | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Push the boundaries of tiling with Kerakoll H40 Extreme, the revolutionary hybrid gel adhesive designed for the toughest conditions you face on site. Engineered to provide extreme flexibility and a smooth, easy application, H40 Extreme ensures a perfect, long-lasting finish on the most challenging substrates.

Its unique gel formula is ten times more deformable than a standard S2 adhesive, providing an incredibly strong and flexible bond that resists stress and movement. This makes it the ultimate solution for large format tiles, underfloor heating systems, and high-traffic areas where performance is critical.

 

  • Extreme Deformability: An incredible 10 times more flexible than S2 adhesives, it absorbs vibrations and structural movement, preventing tile cracks and failures on timber, UFH, and other difficult substrates.
  • Effortless Application: The gel formula is exceptionally fluid and light to trowel, reducing fatigue and speeding up your work. Its thixotropic nature ensures no-slip performance, even with heavy tiles.
  • Fast Bonding, Long Workability: Enjoy a long working time for perfect placement, combined with rapid bonding that allows for foot traffic sooner, helping you complete jobs and move on to the next one faster.
  • Unmatched Versatility: One bag for virtually any job. Provides a powerful bond for all types and sizes of porcelain, ceramic, and natural stone tiles.
  • Built for Extreme Conditions: Tested for the most demanding environments, H40 Extreme is stress-resistant and guarantees the highest level of long-lasting performance.
result.short_description: The new H40 Extreme hybrid Gel adhesive revolutionises the world of reactive adhesives, thanks to its unique fluidity & extreme flexibility, making it the ideal solution for the most extreme installation conditions.

result.description:
Made in the UK and sustainably sourced, this range of laminate wall panels features a smooth matt finish with individual panels sized 59.8x240cm. The bathroom wall panel in White Mineral is the perfect modern touch to white sanitary ware, breaking up a large expanse with a subtle texture in the print’s design.

You can recreate the look of a fully tiled space with the tile effect shower panel walls without the hassle of maintaining any grout in a wet area. The tiled look is achieved by etching the grout line into the laminate surface using a laser.

The Hydrolock fitting system is a watertight finish suitable for bathroom walls. The shower panels can be installed on uneven walls (with a variation of up to 6mm), over the top of existing tiles and have a 30-year warranty when installed correctly.

The click fit bathroom wall panels are easy to keep clean with just a wipe down, with no grout to protect from discolouration, offering a simple fit solution with longevity.
To fit your laminate bathroom wall panels securely and watertight you will require specific fixing essentials depending on your project requirements (for exact configuration requirements please consult your fitter).

 The options available are

  • End Caps – To finish the free edge of your shower panel
  • Corner Pieces – Choose from an internal, flush or invisible fitting depending on your preferred aesthetic
  • Seal Kit – For the bottom of your panels, this solution offers the most secure, watertight seal and most used above a bath fitting
  • Base Profile – An alternative to the seal kit, ideal for floor to ceiling installations, sealed with a bead of silicone, providing a thoroughly seamless finish
  • Angle Profile – applied after installation for external corners, window reveals, doorways or boxing in

Please be aware when Hydrolock joints are manufactured, 18mm is lost from the original panel width e.g.

2400 x 598mm = 2400 x 580mm finished face size*

2400x900mm = 2400 x 882mm finished face size*

2400x1200mm = 2400x1182mm finished face size*

To find out more information, view our How To Fix Laminate Bathroom Wall Panels guide.

Our laminate bathroom wall panels are only available for delivery to mainland UK.

result.description:
Made in the UK and sustainably sourced, our range of laminate wall panels are available in various designs for ultimate style versatility. The dedicated shower panels are in available two sizes, 90x240cm and 120x240cm to suit most shower walls.

The glossy design-led Cappuccino Stone shower panel mimics the look of coloured marble, its deeper hues of grey, anthracite and chocolate brown have an opulent feel, working well with other natural textures and surface finishes to complete your bathroom look.
Designed to create a continuous flow of colour without grout lines or unsightly joints, the Hydrolock fitting system is a watertight finish suitable for bathroom walls. The shower panels can be installed on uneven walls (with a variation of up to 6mm), over the top of existing tiles and have a 30-year warranty when installed correctly.

The click fit bathroom wall panels are easy to keep clean with just a wipe down, with no grout to protect from discolouration, offering a simple fit solution with longevity.

To fit your laminate bathroom wall panels securely and watertight you will require specific fixing essentials depending on your project requirements (for exact configuration requirements please consult your fitter).

 The options available are -

  • End Caps – To finish the free edge of your shower panel
  • Corner Pieces – Choose from an internal, flush or invisible fitting depending on your preferred aesthetic
  • Seal Kit – For the bottom of your panels, this solution offers the most secure, watertight seal and most used above a bath fitting
  • Base Profile – An alternative to the seal kit, ideal for floor to ceiling installations, sealed with a bead of silicone, providing a thoroughly seamless finish
  • Angle Profile – applied after installation for external corners, window reveals, doorways or boxing in

Please be aware when Hydrolock joints are manufactured, 18mm is lost from the original panel width e.g.

2400 x 598mm = 2400 x 580mm finished face size*

2400x900mm = 2400 x 882mm finished face size*

2400x1200mm = 2400x1182mm finished face size*

To find out more information, view our How To Fix Laminate Bathroom Wall Panels guide.

Our laminate bathroom wall panels are only available for delivery to mainland UK.

result.tile_care:
Our extra-large tiles are made from porcelain and should be fitted using a suitable adhesive.

Please refer to the substrate preparation guidelines for the correct adhesive to be used.

Due to the textured surface of the matt tiles, using BAL Protective Sealer before grouting is recommended to aid with the removal of grout during the cleaning process.

Care & Maintenance

For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover.

Directions for use: After grouting wait 10-30 minutes for the grout to thicken in the joint. Carry out an initial clean using a damp sponge then spray Fila Instant Grout Remover over the surface and leave for 2 minutes before cleaning with a damp sponge.

For removing grout which has been left for longer than 30 minutes use diluted Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover.

Directions for use: After grouting, allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes & work residues off with a soft white emulsifying pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water.

Sometimes after using Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover, stubborn residues may be left behind; this may be due to the polymer within the grout. In these instances, use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover diluted 1:5 in the same way as the Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover.

To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used to maintain your porcelain tiles. Fila Multi Surface Cleaner should be used diluted 1:200. Using the correct cleaning product will ensure the life span of your tiles.

Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended.

result.tile_care:
Our extra-large tiles are made from porcelain and should be fitted using a suitable adhesive.

Please refer to the substrate preparation guidelines for the correct adhesive to be used.

Due to the textured surface of the matt tiles, using BAL Protective Sealer before grouting is recommended to aid with the removal of grout during the cleaning process.

Care & Maintenance

For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover.

Directions for use: After grouting wait 10-30 minutes for the grout to thicken in the joint. Carry out an initial clean using a damp sponge then spray Fila Instant Grout Remover over the surface and leave for 2 minutes before cleaning with a damp sponge.

For removing grout which has been left for longer than 30 minutes use diluted Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover.

Directions for use: After grouting, allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes & work residues off with a soft white emulsifying pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water.

Sometimes after using Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover, stubborn residues may be left behind; this may be due to the polymer within the grout. In these instances, use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover diluted 1:5 in the same way as the Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover.

To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used to maintain your porcelain tiles. Fila Multi Surface Cleaner should be used diluted 1:200. Using the correct cleaning product will ensure the life span of your tiles.

Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended.

result.description:
The RUBI Slab Transporter system is specially designed for handling large-format sheets and tiles up to 360cm long and 160cm wide. It can be used as a complement to the Slim Cutter Plus, Slab Cutter and TC-125 cutting systems.

It is made up of a set of two reinforced, retractable and adjustable extruded aluminum guides, and two perpendicular crossbars that increases the robustness and stability of the whole assembly, especially when handling the heaviest pieces.

Thanks to the 6 gray rubber-based vacuum suction cups, the installer can adjust the fixing points, ensuring the handling of the porcelain tiles without fear of the tile surface being marked. The set has 4 handles (2 per guide) that can be adjusted and positioned along the entire length of the guide.

This transport system has been designed mainly for handling large format sheets with a thicknesses of 6mm or more. The design of the aluminum guides gives it a maximum load capacity of up to 170kg.

The vacuum suction pad is a replacement which makes it possible to maintain the original maximum load capacity of the system itself.

result.name: RUBI Slab Cutter
result.category_path: Fixing and Finishing / Tools and accessories / Tile Cutters / Manual tile cutters

media.alt_text: RUBI Slab Cutter.

meta.description: RUBI Slab Cutter
meta.title: RUBI Slab Cutter | Topps Tiles

result.description:
The Slab Cutter manual cutting system allows precise cuts in large-format porcelain sheets. Its guides are made of aluminium to keep the entire tool lightweight. Its exclusive design prevents the scoring carriage from coming out of the guides inadvertently and improves the fixing system between guides thanks to the quick coupling system.

Each Slab Cutter includes three guides that allow you to cut pieces up to 320cm. This capacity can be increased in sections of 110cm for each guide that is incorporated. Each guide integrates two fixing suction cups that have an "anti-marking" rubber base that allows you to work on light-coloured materials without the risk of staining them.

The scoring carriage is very light as it is made of aluminium and exerts a greater scoring power. Its movement through the guides is very smooth and precise due to its three horizontal bearings. The ergonomic "soft-grip" handle provides comfort for the user.

The carriage is equipped with a Ø22mm extreme scoring wheel suitable for working on tiles with rough and structured surface finishes and tiles with smooth or polished finishes.

The cutter includes the scoring carriage and Slab pliers with the ability to separate materials up to 10mm thick. The pliers have dual functionality: pliers for materials up to 6mm thick and a clamp screw for those materials up to 10mm.
result.short_description: The Slab Cutter manual cutting system allows precise cuts in large-format porcelain sheets. Its guides are made of aluminium to keep the entire tool lightweight. Its exclusive design prevents the scoring carriage from coming out of the guides inadvertently and improves the fixing system between guides thanks to the quick coupling system.

result.name: RUBI Triller 230V
result.category_path: Fixing and Finishing / Tools and accessories / RUBI

meta.description: RUBI Triller 230V
meta.title: RUBI Triller 230V | Topps Tiles

result.description:
The RUBI Triller is a lightweight and compact vibrator for tiles, specially designed to avoid the generation of encapsulated air bubbles between the adhesive and the back of the ceramic tile. Facilitating, in this way, an ideal adhesion between adhesive and tile.

The Triller is recommended, to a greater extent, in porcelain sheet installation work. Above all, in formats greater than 300cm x 100cm. It can also be used for the installation and correct fixing of uncoupling or waterproofing sheets.

With low weight at only 4.8kg, it facilitates its use on vertical supports and work at height. In addition, the design of its floating carbon steel chassis incorporates a careful vibration reduction system that avoids the return to the user. The base of contact with the ceramic tile does not leave marks and is easily replaceable.

meta.description:
DEX Manual Cutter 400mm Meet DEX, a high-quality innovative tiling tool range with eco awareness at great prices.
The DEX range of manual cutters have been designed with you in mind, a condensed range of two cutters covering the key tile sizes, featuring all the design requirements our surveyed customers needed in a top-quality tile cutter.
The cutters feature linear bearings designed for smoother scoring, not found in a product of this price anywhere else, along with a 22mm titanium scoring wheel comparable to top tool brands like RUBI. Its magnetic breaking device provides clear visibility with a breaking strain of 800KG, enabling a cutting thickness of up to 12mm.
These high-quality cutters also include a breaker foot for mosaic tiles, a spare titanium scoring wheel, an extension bar for tile support and an adjustable measuring guide for those precise cuts all with a reinforced steel base and ergonomic grip for comfort.
This range of manual cutters are packaged in recyclable car

result.name: Rise Matting 150w 1.5m²
result.category_path: Fixing and Finishing / Underfloor Heating / Under-Tile Heating

meta.description:
Rise Matting 150w 1.5m² Utilising the best technology, premium materials and rigorous testing, the Rise underfloor heating solution is an affordable and effective way to heat your home. The no nonsense and uncomplicated heating system is easy to fit and use, providing peace of mind whilst preparing your home for the future.
The Rise underfloor heating matting is most suited to standard shaped rooms and covering larger areas when considering the use of under tile heating. Simply roll the matting out, stick the matting down onto the substrate to fix in place, then cut the matting (avoiding cutting the wire) to size and then it’s ready to tile over. When connecting electrical systems, a fully qualified electrician should carry out the work. We also recommend using the best under tile insulation to produce the most energy efficient results.

Suitable for use under ceramic, porcelain and natural stone in your bathroom, kitchen, hallway, conservatory and living room
160 Watts
Up to 15m²
meta.title: Rise Matting 150w 1.5m² | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Utilising the best technology, premium materials and rigorous testing, the Rise underfloor heating solution is an affordable and effective way to heat your home. The no nonsense and uncomplicated heating system is easy to fit and use, providing peace of mind whilst preparing your home for the future.

Rise underfloor heating matting is best suited to regular shaped rooms and is available in six sizes, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 10 and 15m², giving you the flexibility to cover a range of room sizes. Simply roll the matting out, press the self-adhesive, fibreglass mesh down onto the substrate to fix it securely in place. At the end of each row, cut the matting as required ensuring to avoid cutting through the cable, and it is ready to cover. When connecting electrical systems, a fully qualified electrician should carry out the work. We also recommend using Rise warm up insulation boards to produce the most energy efficient results.

  • Suitable for use under ceramic, porcelain and natural stone in any room of the home
  • 150W output
  • Available in 6 sizes: 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 10 and 15m²
  • Ultra slim design with 3.5mm multi strand, twin core and double insulated heating cable
  • Self adhesive fibreglass mesh for secure and durable installation
  • Can be used as a primary or secondary heating solution for energy and cost savings
  • UKCA marked, meeting EU energy efficiency standards
  • 10 year warranty
  • Exclusive to Topps Tiles

For more information, including simple to use fitting videos, please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Made in the UK and sustainably sourced, our range of laminate faced bathroom wall panels are available in various designs for ultimate style versatility. The dedicated shower panels are available in two sizes, 90x240cm and 120x240cm to suit most shower walls.

The Jupiter Silver shower panel mimics the look of natural stone with its matt finish and subtle textured detailing. The unique stone effect mixes neutral tones of cream and grey for a relaxing aesthetic. 

Designed to create a continuous flow of colour without grout lines or unsightly joints, the Hydrolock fitting system is a watertight finish suitable for bathroom walls. The shower panels can be installed on uneven walls (with a variation of up to 6mm), over the top of existing tiles and have a 30-year warranty when installed correctly.

The click fit bathroom wall panels are easy to keep clean with just a wipe down, with no grout to protect from discolouration, offering a simple fit solution with longevity.

To fit your laminate bathroom wall panels securely and watertight you will require specific fixing essentials depending on your project requirements (for exact configuration requirements please consult your fitter).

The options available are -

  • End Caps – To finish the free edge of your shower panel
  • Corner Pieces – Choose from an internal, flush or invisible fitting depending on your preferred aesthetic
  • Seal Kit – For the bottom of your panels, this solution offers the most secure, watertight seal and most used above a bath fitting
  • Base Profile – An alternative to the seal kit, ideal for floor to ceiling installations, sealed with a bead of silicone, providing a thoroughly seamless finish
  • Angle Profile – applied after installation for external corners, window reveals, doorways or boxing in

Please be aware when Hydrolock joints are manufactured, 18mm is lost from the original panel width e.g.

2400 x 598mm = 2400 x 580mm finished face size*

2400x900mm = 2400 x 882mm finished face size*

2400x1200mm = 2400x1182mm finished face size*

To find out more information, view our How To Fix Laminate Bathroom Wall Panels guide.

Our laminate bathroom wall panels are only available for delivery to mainland UK.

result.description:
Made in the UK and sustainably sourced, our range of laminate faced bathroom wall panels are available in four designs in both a matt and gloss finish for ultimate style versatility. The dedicated shower panels are in two sizes, 90x240cm and 120x240cm to suit most shower walls.

The Marfil Cream shower panel has a textured matt finish, designed to feel like real stone whilst its creamy warm undertones create a spa-like sanctuary for your morning shower.

Designed to create a continuous flow of colour without grout lines or unsightly joints, the Hydrolock fitting system is a watertight finish suitable for bathroom walls. The shower panels can be installed on uneven walls (with a variation of up to 6mm), over the top of existing tiles and have a 30-year warranty when installed correctly.

The click fit bathroom wall panels are easy to keep clean with just a wipe down, with no grout to protect from discolouration, offering a simple fit solution with longevity.

To fit your laminate bathroom wall panels securely and watertight you will require specific fixing essentials depending on your project requirements (for exact configuration requirements please consult your fitter) The options available are -

  • End Caps – To finish the free edge of your shower panel
  • Corner Pieces – Choose from an internal, flush or invisible fitting depending on your preferred aesthetic
  • Seal Kit – For the bottom of your panels, this solution offers the most secure, watertight seal and most used above a bath fitting
  • Base Profile – An alternative to the seal kit, ideal for floor to ceiling installations, sealed with a bead of silicone, providing a thoroughly seamless finish
  • Angle Profile – applied after installation for external corners, window reveals, doorways or boxing in

Please be aware when Hydrolock joints are manufactured, 18mm is lost from the original panel width e.g.

2400 x 598mm = 2400 x 580mm finished face size*

2400x900mm = 2400 x 882mm finished face size*

2400x1200mm = 2400x1182mm finished face size*

To find out more information, view our How To Fix Laminate Bathroom Wall Panels guide.

Our laminate bathroom wall panels are only available for delivery to mainland UK.

result.name: Acton™ White Tile (30cm x 7.5cm)
result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

It’s hardwearing porcelain meaning little upkeep is needed and with multiple ways to fit it, it’s an easy DIY solution for the budding landscape designer in all of us. The 2cm depth coupled with the slip resistant surface provides ultimate durability and safety.

  • Variety of sizes and formats available
  • 2cm depth
  • High slip resistance
  • Nonporous so tiles won’t ‘pop’ or crack in freezing temperatures
  • No specialist sealing or cleaning required
  • Suitable for use with a pressure washer
  • Multiple fitting solutions available

Complete your Everscape tiling project with our one-stop shop for outdoor tiling. Choose from our range of outdoor adhesives, leveller, pedestals systems, outdoor suitable grouts, finishing trims as well as outdoor tools and cutters. The range of TX-MAX professional manual cutters from Rubi are perfect for intensive cutting of all types of ceramic tile. Thanks to its high performance multipoint breaker and its rotating square system, TX-MAX models allow easy and quick execution of angular cuts (from 0º to 45º), especially in porcelain stoneware tiles.

result.name: Skandi™ Oak Plank Tile (121cm x 19.5cm)
result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Instant Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila First Wash Extra Strong

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Tile & Stone Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Tile & Stone Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Protector

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Grout Protector residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Cadence™ Pearl Tile (31.6cm x 60cm) The Cadence range has been designed to replicate the beauty of the Zellige tile. Originating in Morocco, the handcrafted tiles were made from a special blend of clay and then glazed and fired, producing irregularities in the surface for a unique look.
Cadence is available in a range of muted tones for an authentic finish, the glossy finish rebounding the natural light to create a dapple effect thanks to its rustic surface texture. Designed to look like 18 10x10cm individual squares, the Cadence tile is a 30x60cm ceramic wall tile, saving time in installation. Simply grout with a 2mm grout line around the main tile and the tile’s faux grout lines will perfectly marry up.
Match the grout line with BAL’s Micromax3 Eco in White.

result.description:
Our range of PVC faced bathroom wall panels are available in four designs that replicate the look of quartz, marble and concrete for ultimate style versatility. Designs are available in 100x240cm sized panels to suit most shower walls.

Designed to create a continuous flow of colour without grout lines, the PVC shower panels are waterproof and suitable for bathroom walls, simply apply a bead of silicone between the panel joints when using in a wet and humid environment.

White Crystal has a gloss finish to allow the quartz-like particles in the design to sparkle in the light. Adding a clean, sophisticated finish to your shower room, this PVC shower panel suits a number of bathroom styles with its classic finish.

The shower panels can be installed over the top of existing tiles, as long as they are secure and flat, and must be sanded and then clean to ensure the adhesive grabs.

These PVC bathroom wall panels are easy to keep clean with a non-abrasive and antibacterial cleaner, with no grout to protect from discolouration, offering a simple fit solution with longevity.

To fit your PVC bathroom wall panels securely and watertight, a range of installation and finishing accessories are required. These essential pieces are available in black, white and silver finishes to complement your PVC panels.

  • Internal Corner (56x240x1cm) - The internal corner joint should be used to connect two panels together to sit neatly into an adjoining corner.
  • External Corner (37x240x1cm) - The external corner joint connects two panels together that are facing away from each other.
  • End Cap (25x240x1cm) - The end cap is required at the end of each panel where it is not joined to another panel (via a H joint).

To find out more information, view our How To Fix PVC Bathroom Wall Panels guide.

result.description:
Offering a customisable underfloor heating solution, the DCM-Pro System uses unique decoupling technology to protect tiled floors by absorbing lateral subfloor movement. With 40% faster installation, the peel and stick mat can be stuck directly on to the substrate, with no adhesive required, keeping the floor height to a minimum. It’s available in a single mat size (0.73m2) or a 14m2 roll depending on your project size.

The dimensions of the membrane are designed to work with the heating cable, so 2m2 of heating cable fits exactly in 2m2 of the membrane. However, the spacing of the cable, which just slots in by hand into the castellated design, can be adjusted to suit your desired coverage and power.

meta.description:
Dakota Levelling Clips 1mm (Pack of 250) 
1mm Levelling Clips.
Developed to ensure the installation of tiles are levelled at the point where tiles meet.
They’re designed to prevent tiles from warping as the adhesive cures.
The Dakota Levelling System doesn’t require the use of pliers to tighten the clips.
Allows for faster tile laying and prevents the lifting of tiles from the adhesive bed. These thinner clips are easier to break off making them quicker to work with.
Works with a tile depth of 3mm – 12mm.
Levelling Clips should be used in conjunction with tile spacers as they are not designed to accurately space tiles apart. We recommend using a 3-4mm grout width with larger tiles.
Pack of 250 clips, wedges are sold separately.

result.name: Foundry™ 2.5m Tarnish Straight Edge 12.5mm Trim
result.category_path: Fixing and Finishing / Tile Trims & Tile Edging

meta.title: Foundry™ Trims | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Providing a durable and decorative finish, this Foundry trim is comprised of solid brass to create a luxurious 2.5m edging strip in a straight edge profile, available in 10mm and 12.5mm.

The brass trim is handcrafted for an authentic vintage look, taking inspiration from historical architecture. Nature also plays a role with the process of oxidisation which, over time, creates an organic looking patina on the surface of the trim.

If desired, the application of Topps Tiles’ Foundry Beeswax can slow down the oxidisation process. Simply remove any existing layers of oxidisation using conventional polishing agents and a non-abrasive cloth and then apply a thin layer of the wax.

  • When placing the product, ensure it does not come into contact with the tile adhesive or grout. If contact is made, wipe down straight away using clean water and then dry with a lint-free cloth.
  • Avoid contact with trowels, steel wool and other metal items to prevent scrapes and scratches.
  • Brass profiles can be mitred if using for window frames, part-tiled walls, external corners, and surrounding splashbacks.
  • Ensure care is taken around cut edges of the trim to prevent injury during installation.
  • Do not use any cement stain removers or chemically active cleaning products when wiping down the product's surface.

result.name: Everscape™ Granite Grey Outdoor Tile (60cm x 90cm)

breadcrumbs.label: Everscape™ Granite Grey Outdoor Tile (60cm x 90cm)

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax2 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray FILA Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila First Wash Extra Strong

Directions for use: Dilute FILA First Wash Extra Strong 1:5 with clean water (1 litre First Wash with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Protector.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Extend your style outside and learn to love your garden all year round! From sun drenched patios and secret courtyard gardens to cosy city balconies and breezy beachfront terraces, our exclusive range of outdoor tiles will help transform every corner of your home into spaces you’ll never want to leave, creating the perfect space for endless summers.

Everscape is a range of specialised 2cm deep outdoor tiles with an amalgamation of ‘forever’ and ‘landscape’ embodied in its spirit. This combination of elegant, simple design married with innovative technology allows you to make a real investment in your outdoor space for years to come.

It’s hardwearing porcelain meaning little upkeep is needed and with multiple ways to fit it, it’s an easy DIY solution for the budding landscape designer in all of us. The 2cm depth coupled with the slip resistant surface provides ultimate durability and safety.

Create a natural feeling in your garden landscaping with this granite effect tile range. 

Key Product Features:

  • Variety of sizes and formats available
  • 2cm depth
  • High slip resistance
  • Nonporous so tiles won’t ‘pop’ or crack in freezing temperatures
  • No specialist sealing or cleaning required
  • Suitable for use with a pressure washer
  • Multiple fitting solutions available
  • A range of complementary finishing accessories are available
  • 1cm deep coordinating indoor tiles available

Complete your Everscape tiling project with our one-stop shop for outdoor tiling. Choose from our range of outdoor adhesives, leveller, pedestals systems, outdoor suitable grouts, finishing trims as well as outdoor tools and cutters. And once your project is complete, help maintain your finished patio with the Fila Outdoor Patio Cleaner.

Fitting the Everscape range yourself? Check out the fitting guides on our Knowledge Base for some useful tips for laying on grass, gravel, cement, and pedestals.

result.description:
Outdoor tiles to make the most of every day.

Extend your style outside and learn to love your garden all year round! From sun drenched patios and secret courtyard gardens to cosy city balconies and breezy beachfront terraces, our exclusive range of outdoor tiles will help transform every corner of your home into spaces you’ll never want to leave, creating the perfect space for endless summers.

Everscape is a range of specialised 2cm deep outdoor tiles with an amalgamation of ‘forever’ and ‘landscape’ embodied in its spirit. This combination of elegant, simple design married with innovative technology allows you to make a real investment in your outdoor space for years to come.

It’s hardwearing porcelain meaning little upkeep is needed and with multiple ways to fit it, it’s an easy DIY solution for the budding landscape designer in all of us. The 2cm depth coupled with the slip resistant surface provides ultimate durability and safety.

Create a decorative stone effect finish to your outdoor pathway or patio with Everscape’s Marb Stone Grey.

Key Product Features:

  • Variety of sizes and formats available
  • 2cm depth
  • High slip resistance
  • Nonporous so tiles won’t ‘pop’ or crack in freezing temperatures
  • No specialist sealing or cleaning required
  • Suitable for use with a pressure washer
  • Multiple fitting solutions available
  • A range of complementary finishing accessories are available
  • 1cm deep coordinating indoor tiles available

Complete your Everscape tiling project with our one-stop shop for outdoor tiling. Choose from our range of outdoor adhesives, leveller, pedestals systems, outdoor suitable grouts, finishing trims as well as outdoor tools and cutters. And once your project is complete, help maintain your finished patio with the Fila Outdoor Patio Cleaner.

Fitting the Everscape range yourself? Check out the fitting guides on our Knowledge Base for some useful tips for laying on grass, gravel, cement, and pedestals.

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax2 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray FILA Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila First Wash Extra Strong

Directions for use: Dilute FILA First Wash Extra Strong 1:5 with clean water (1 litre First Wash with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Protector.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

media.alt_text: Kelham Loft™ Chalk Tile with reeded texture fitted on bathroom wall with a rectangular mirror and white wall mounted basin.

result.tile_care:
The use of BAL Protective Sealer is required prior to grouting when using contrasting, dark pigmented grout colours.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile

result.description:
This modern reeded tile has been given a rustic edge with Kelham Loft’s natural, earthy colour palette, inspired by traditional Spanish terracotta bricks. The on-trend reeded design provides a tactile approach to creating depth and interest.

This versatile design can tap into the modern country look with its rustic surface detailing, simply pair it with minimalist style furniture or cabinetry and hints of oak. Alternatively, be influenced by the industrial heritage of Kelham Island in Sheffield and go for a darker, moodier palette with streamlined contemporary furnishings and accents of marble for an eclectic maximalist finish.

The unique ribbed design comes with two variations, a single thick band at one end and a thick band top and bottom. These designs are mixed within each box in a random quantity.

Recycled Content: 50%

We do not recommend using any dark pigmented grout colours such as Micromax3 Eco Ebony Grout on this range and the BAL Protective Sealer is required prior to grouting.

result.description:
Offering a customisable underfloor heating solution, the DCM-Pro System uses unique decoupling technology to protect tiled floors by absorbing lateral subfloor movement.

The Fleece-backed membrane option is used with a separate adhesive, ideal for damp subfloors, coarse or irregular subfloors and with levelling compounds on top. Allowing for flexible installation, the membrane can be repositioned whilst laying.

The dimensions of the membrane are designed to work with the heating cable, so 2m2 of heating cable fits exactly in 2m2 of the membrane. However, the spacing of the cable, which just slots in by hand into the castellated design, can be adjusted to suit your desired coverage and power.

result.tile_care:
We recommend cleaning our shower panels with a micro-fibre cloth, warm water, and a non-abrasive mild detergent. Scouring powders or similar products should not be used.

Wiping after use should be sufficient to prevent staining in most cases. Lime scale residues may be removed using a soft cloth and Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Commercial lime-scale removers are not recommended.

Avoid contact with bleach, tanning agents, hair dyes and root restorers as these products could harm the laminate. If one of these substances accidentally comes into contact with the panel, rinse immediately with plenty of warm water.

result.description:
Made in the UK and sustainably sourced, this range of laminate wall panels feature a smooth matt finish with individual panels sized 59.8x240cm. You can recreate the look of a fully tiled space with the tile effect shower panel walls without the hassle of maintaining any grout in a wet area. The tiled look is achieved by etching the grout line into the laminate surface using a laser.

The herringbone design mimics the look of small format, rectangular tiles in a herringbone laying pattern. The soft sage green shade adds a touch of serenity to your shower space.

The Hydrolock fitting system is a watertight finish suitable for bathroom walls. The shower panels can be installed on uneven walls (with a variation of up to 6mm), over the top of existing tiles and have a 30-year warranty when installed correctly.

The click fit bathroom wall panels are easy to keep clean with just a wipe down, with no grout to protect from discolouration, offering a simple fit solution with longevity.

To fit your laminate bathroom wall panels securely and watertight you will require specific fixing essentials depending on your project requirements (for exact configuration requirements please consult your fitter) The options available are:

  • End Caps – To finish the free edge of your shower panel
  • Corner Pieces – Choose from an internal, flush or invisible fitting depending on your preferred aesthetic
  • Seal Kit – For the bottom of your panels, this solution offers the most secure, watertight seal and most used above a bath fitting
  • Base Profile – An alternative to the seal kit, ideal for floor to ceiling installations, sealed with a bead of silicone, providing a thoroughly seamless finish
  • Angle Profile – applied after installation for external corners, window reveals, doorways or boxing in

Please be aware when Hydrolock joints are manufactured, 18mm is lost from the original panel width e.g.

2400 x 598mm = 2400 x 580mm finished face size*

To find out more information, view our How To Fix Laminate Bathroom Wall Panels guide.

DELIVERY

  • When ordering our laminate bathroom wall panels, the order will be placed with our supplier and will be fulfilled in 3-5 working days to the kerbside of your delivery address.
  • Whilst a tradesperson isn’t required on-site for delivery, it would be beneficial due to the size of the product.

result.description:
Made in the UK and sustainably sourced, this range of laminate wall panels feature a smooth matt finish with individual panels sized 59.8x240cm. You can recreate the look of a fully tiled space with the tile effect shower panel walls without the hassle of maintaining any grout in a wet area. The tiled look is achieved by etching the grout line into the laminate surface using a laser.

The herringbone design mimics the look of small format, rectangular tiles in a herringbone laying pattern. The misty blue shade adds a touch of brightness to your shower space.

The Hydrolock fitting system is a watertight finish suitable for bathroom walls. The shower panels can be installed on uneven walls (with a variation of up to 6mm), over the top of existing tiles and have a 30-year warranty when installed correctly.

The click fit bathroom wall panels are easy to keep clean with just a wipe down, with no grout to protect from discolouration, offering a simple fit solution with longevity.

To fit your laminate bathroom wall panels securely and watertight you will require specific fixing essentials depending on your project requirements (for exact configuration requirements please consult your fitter) The options available are:

  • End Caps – To finish the free edge of your shower panel
  • Corner Pieces – Choose from an internal, flush or invisible fitting depending on your preferred aesthetic
  • Seal Kit – For the bottom of your panels, this solution offers the most secure, watertight seal and most used above a bath fitting
  • Base Profile – An alternative to the seal kit, ideal for floor to ceiling installations, sealed with a bead of silicone, providing a thoroughly seamless finish
  • Angle Profile – applied after installation for external corners, window reveals, doorways or boxing in

Please be aware when Hydrolock joints are manufactured, 18mm is lost from the original panel width e.g.

2400 x 598mm = 2400 x 580mm finished face size*

2400x900mm = 2400 x 882mm finished face size*

2400x1200mm = 2400x1182mm finished face size*

meta.description: Warmup DCM-Pro Fleece Backed
meta.title: Warmup DCM-Pro Fleece Backed | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Offering a customisable underfloor heating solution, the DCM-Pro System uses unique decoupling technology to protect tiled floors by absorbing lateral subfloor movement.

The Fleece-backed membrane option is used with a separate adhesive, ideal for damp subfloors, coarse or irregular subfloors and with levelling compounds on top. Allowing for flexible installation, the membrane can be repositioned whilst laying.

The dimensions of the membrane are designed to work with the heating cable, so 2m2 of heating cable fits exactly in 2m2 of the membrane. However, the spacing of the cable, which just slots in by hand into the castellated design, can be adjusted to suit your desired coverage and power.

When tiling over DCM Pro, tiles should be fixed directly onto the matting using an S1 cement-based flexible tile adhesive. The use of a levelling compound over DCM Pro is not recommended where tiles are the final floor finish

media.alt_text: Matrix® Pebble Beige Matt Square Tile.

result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer’s instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Made in the UK and sustainably sourced, our range of laminate faced bathroom wall panels are available in four designs in both a matt and gloss finish for ultimate style versatility. The dedicated shower panels are in two sizes, 90x240cm and 120x240cm to suit most shower walls.

Black Pietra adds bold glamour to your shower in this laminate wall panel format, the subtle satin finish lends a touch of opulence to the deep tones of this charcoal black marble effect.

Designed to create a continuous flow of colour without grout lines or unsightly joints, the Hydrolock fitting system is a watertight finish suitable for bathroom walls. The shower panels can be installed on uneven walls (with a variation of up to 6mm), over the top of existing tiles and have a 30-year warranty when installed correctly.

The click fit bathroom wall panels are easy to keep clean with just a wipe down, with no grout to protect from discolouration, offering a simple fit solution with longevity.

To fit your laminate bathroom wall panels securely and watertight you will require specific fixing essentials depending on your project requirements (for exact configuration requirements please consult your fitter) The options available are

  • End Caps – To finish the free edge of your shower panel
  • Corner Pieces – Choose from an internal, flush or invisible fitting depending on your preferred aesthetic
  • Seal Kit – For the bottom of your panels, this solution offers the most secure, watertight seal and most used above a bath fitting
  • Base Profile – An alternative to the seal kit, ideal for floor to ceiling installations, sealed with a bead of silicone, providing a thoroughly seamless finish
  • Angle Profile – applied after installation for external corners, window reveals, doorways or boxing in

Please be aware when Hydrolock joints are manufactured, 18mm is lost from the original panel width e.g.

2400 x 598mm = 2400 x 580mm finished face size*

2400x900mm = 2400 x 882mm finished face size*

2400x1200mm = 2400x1182mm finished face size*

To find out more information, view our How To Fix Laminate Bathroom Wall Panels guide.

Our laminate bathroom wall panels are only available for delivery to mainland UK.

To fit your laminate bathroom wall panels securely and watertight you will require specific fixing essentials depending on your project requirements (for exact configuration requirements please consult your fitter) The options available are -

  • End Caps – To finish the free edge of your shower panel
  • Corner Pieces – Choose from an internal, flush or invisible fitting depending on your preferred aesthetic
  • Seal Kit – For the bottom of your panels, this solution offers the most secure, watertight seal and most used above a bath fitting
  • Base Profile – An alternative to the seal kit, ideal for floor to ceiling installations, sealed with a bead of silicone, providing a thoroughly seamless finish
  • Angle Profile – applied after installation for external corners, window reveals, doorways or boxing in

Please be aware when Hydrolock joints are manufactured, 18mm is lost from the original panel width e.g.

2400 x 598mm = 2400 x 580mm finished face size*

2400x900mm = 2400 x 882mm finished face size*

2400x1200mm = 2400x1182mm finished face size*

To find out more information, view our How To Fix Laminate Bathroom Wall Panels guide.

Our laminate bathroom wall panels are only available for delivery to mainland UK.

result.tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.name: Roselle Beige Tile (60cm x 60cm)
result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.
