result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.name: Everscape™ Valletta Grey Outdoor Tile (60cm x 60cm)

breadcrumbs.label: Everscape™ Valletta Grey Outdoor Tile (60cm x 60cm)

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.description:
Outdoor tiles to make the most of every day.

Extend your style outside and learn to love your garden all year round! From sun drenched patios and secret courtyard gardens to cosy city balconies and breezy beachfront terraces, our exclusive range of outdoor tiles will help transform every corner of your home into spaces you’ll never want to leave, creating the perfect space for endless summers.

Everscape is a range of specialised 2cm deep outdoor tiles with an amalgamation of ‘forever’ and ‘landscape’ embodied in its spirit. This combination of elegant, simple design married with innovative technology allows you to make a real investment in your outdoor space for years to come.

It's hardwearing porcelain meaning little upkeep is needed and with multiple ways to fit it, it’s an easy DIY solution for the budding landscape designer in all of us. The 2cm depth coupled with the slip resistant surface provides ultimate durability and safety all year round. Recapture the rustic elegance of Malta’s capital city with Valletta.

This specialist outdoor tile has a hammered finish for that rustic feel, creating depth and texture in the hard landscaping of your garden.

Key Product Features:

  • Variety of sizes and formats available
  • 2cm depth 
  • Nonporous so tiles won’t ‘pop’ or crack in freezing temperatures
  • No specialist sealing or cleaning required
  • Suitable for use with a pressure washer
  • Multiple fitting solutions available
  • A range of complementary finishing accessories are available

Complete your Everscape tiling project with our one-stop shop for outdoor tiling. Choose from our range of outdoor adhesives, leveller, pedestals systems, outdoor suitable grouts, finishing trims as well as outdoor tools and cutters. And once your project is complete, help maintain your finished patio with the Fila Outdoor Patio Cleaner.

Fitting the Everscape range yourself? Check out the fitting guides on our Knowledge Base for some useful tips for laying on grass, gravel, cement, and pedestals.

result.name: Nepal Ice Tile (33cm x 33cm)
result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.name: Black Glass Splashback (59.5cm x 74.5cm)
result.tile_care:
Avoid using acetoxy or acetic curing adhesive as they can negatively affect the paint and become visible once the adhesive is fully cured.

Ensure that the glass splashback is not placed too close to the gas hob flame. Maintain a distance of at least 100mm from the face of the splashback.

Ensure the gas hob is installed in a way that prevents direct contact or close proximity between the flame and the splashback. Failure to do so could damage the colour coating and glass, invalidating the guarantee.  

Acclimatise the glass splashback before installation to allow the adhesive tape to warm up to +10 degrees Celsius. Applying the tape in colder temperatures may affect its bonding. Do not apply directly onto a tiled wall.

Aftercare: Is it recommended that the glass splashbacks should be protected with FILA Multi Surface Cleaner. Avoid using abrasive cleaners or materials.

breadcrumbs.label: Everscape™ Kemble™ Grey Outdoor Tile (59.8cm x 59.8cm)

result.tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

result.tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see the grout manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Working in small areas of 1m², spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 in clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue
This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and wash using a cloth or large brush and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.
Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Meet BAL’s Micromax 3 Eco grout range, a rapid-setting, rapid-hardening and highly flexible cementitious tiling grout.

meta.title: Sigma Jolly Edge 37A3D | Topps Tiles

result.description:
Outdoor tiles, swimming pool edges and even tiled skirting often require an edge finish, and if not using a trim, they should be mitred or bullnosed. Prefabricated products are expensive and often take weeks to manufacture, the solution? A specialist tool to get the job done.

The Sigma Jolly Edge has been specially designed for creating a finished edge to a tile, whether it be an attractive bullnosed edge or a clean mitre for creating an angled edge, ideal for steps.

The innovative cutter rests on the edge of the tile and ensures a uniformed mitre across the length you are cutting. When used in conjunction with a diamond blade it can create a mitred edge at any angle from 40-50˚ and can work a single pass with tiles 5-20mm thick. Alternatively, use a diamond grinding wheel to achieve a bullnosed edge with a radius of 6-10mm.

Wet cutting offers a cleaner cut and will require a water kit along with the grinder being cordless. For dry cutting, the use of a vacuum or mask for dust extraction is required.

This product comes with the Sigma Diamond Blade.

result.name: RUBI Tile Regulator
result.category_path: Fixing and Finishing / Tools and accessories

meta.description: RUBI Tile Regulator
meta.title: RUBI Tile Regulator | Topps Tiles

result.description:
With the RUBI Tile Regulator, the professional tile installer will be able to quickly and precisely adjust the laying joint generated when installing the tile, both in wall coverings and on flooring.

The RUBI Tile Regulator is especially designed for work with porcelain sheets and large-format tiles. These large materials are very difficult to adjust once they have been laid. The strength of the double-glue adhesion generates a lot of resistance and the user must exert great efforts and risk the possibility of damaging the material. To facilitate this process, RUBI makes the Tile Regulator available to professionals. Equipped with two 150mm diameter vacuum suction cups suitable for a wide variety of surface finishes.

The Regulator is fixed to two different tiles, to the one that has just been installed and to another previously installed one. Once the suction cups are attached to both pieces, you can adjust the size of the placement joint from 0 to 40mm maximum. The tile regulator also allows you to adjust the horizontal level of the pieces in a range from 0 to 20mm and in pieces up to a maximum weight of 100kg.

For cases in which it is necessary to work with very large formats, it is recommended to always use two Tile Regulators. In this way, a much faster and more precise adjustment of the installed tile will be obtained.

The RUBI Tile Regulator is especially designed for work with porcelain sheets and large-format tiles. These large materials are very difficult to adjust once they have been laid. The strength of the double-glue adhesion generates a lot of resistance and the user must exert great efforts and risk the possibility of damaging the material.
